title: Tell the agent you are away, and come back
done: That is it: the agent welcomes you back, and takes you through what is pending one item at a time.

steps.caption: Away tells the agent that you have stepped away.
Press it, and give the time you expect to be back, if you know it.
While you are away, the agent keeps its questions for your return, and goes on with work that does not need you.

notes.text: Kept for your return: shall the slow fixtures run too?

steps.caption: Here the agent keeps a question for you, as a note.
The button shows that you are away, and until when.
Your turn: press Away to say that you are back.
